tasks.title: Essay: Reducing waste at public events
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
In your English class you have been talking about how to reduce waste at public events such as concerts or sports matches. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most effective way to reduce waste at public events?

Notes

Write about:

1. reusable food containers
2. clear sorting stations
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Review: An environmentally responsible event
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in your college English-language magazine.

Reviews wanted!

Have you been to an event recently that tried to be environmentally responsible? It could be a festival, a sports event, a market or something else.

Write a review of the event. Describe one specific environmental action the organisers took, explain how it affected your experience as a visitor, and say whether you would recommend the event to others based on its environmental efforts.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Article: Low-waste habits for young adults
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement on a lifestyle website for young adults.

Articles wanted!

Low-waste living: small changes that stick

We are collecting practical habits that young people can adopt to reduce waste. Write an article for our website.

Describe one shopping choice you make to avoid waste and one habit related to food or packaging that you follow. Explain how you manage to keep these habits consistently.

We will publish the best articles on our site.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Email: Helping organise a school event with a waste-reduction target
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You have received this email from your friend Sam, who is helping to organise a multi-school event and wants to reduce waste.

From: Sam
Subject: Help with the school event!

Hi,

I'm on the organising team for the big multi-school event next month, and we've set a target to reduce waste by 30%. I know you're good at this kind of thing. Could you help out? Let me know which responsibility you'd like to take on – for example, managing the reuse system for cups or supervising the sorting stations.

Also, what two measures do you think we should introduce? And why those? Finally, do you have any questions about the suppliers we're using?

Thanks a lot!
Sam

Write your email.
